description: This PHP class 'ProjectReport' is part of the OrangeHRM time reporting module. It implements the 'EndpointAwareReport' interface and provides functionalities for preparing filter parameters, validation rules, report headers, filters, and data related to project reports. It also includes access control checks. The class is designed to handle HTTP request parameters, perform validation, and generate report data for project time tracking within the HR system.

classes.name: ProjectReport
classes.description: A report class for generating project time tracking data within OrangeHRM, including filter processing, validation, header configuration, data retrieval, and access control.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares filter parameters from the incoming request, including project ID, date range, and inclusion of timesheet approval status.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the request parameters, including required and optional fields with specific validation constraints.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the header configuration for the report, including column definitions with internationalized labels.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns the filter configuration for the report (currently an empty filter).

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on the provided filter parameters, producing a 'ProjectReportData' object.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view the report; throws a ForbiddenException if not authorized.
